context: Evaluates the use of mathjs expression tree manipulation to parse and analyze the structure of mathematical expressions.

checklist.name: parsing to AST
checklist.description: Uses parse() to convert the expression string into an abstract syntax tree

checklist.name: tree traversal
checklist.description: Uses traverse() or filter() to visit nodes in the expression tree

checklist.description: Checks node types using properties like node.type or type-checking methods (isOperatorNode, isSymbolNode, isFunctionNode)
